options.label: Process
options.description: 通过 Telegraf procstat 按进程名/命令行匹配采集 CPU 与内存

options.label: Port
options.description: 启用端口存活探测：勾选后表格出现端口列，仅对填写了端口的进程做 TCP 探测
options.description_en: Enable TCP port liveness checks. When selected, the Ports column appears; only rows with ports configured are probed.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）

table_columns.name: process_name
table_columns.label: 进程名称
table_columns.description: 进程别名，写入指标维度 process_name，用于监控列表与主机进程视图展示。
table_columns.description_en: Process alias written to the process_name metric dimension for list and host process views.
table_columns.guide_short: 这里填展示用的进程别名，不必与系统进程名完全一致；同主机下建议唯一。
table_columns.guide_short_en: Display name for this process row. It does not have to match the OS process name; keep it unique on the same host.

table_columns.name: pattern
table_columns.label: 匹配规则
table_columns.description: Telegraf procstat 匹配表达式，按进程名或命令行片段定位目标进程。
table_columns.description_en: Telegraf procstat pattern that matches target processes by name or command-line fragment.
table_columns.guide_short: 按进程名或命令行片段匹配，例如 nginx、java.*OrderService；匹配到的进程会汇总到上方的进程名称。
table_columns.guide_short_en: Match by process name or command-line fragment, e.g. nginx or java.*OrderService. Matched processes roll up under Process Name.

table_columns.name: ports
table_columns.label: 端口
table_columns.description: 可选。逗号分隔的 TCP 端口列表；留空表示该进程不做端口存活探测。
table_columns.description_en: Optional comma-separated TCP ports. Leave empty to skip port liveness for this process.
